name: reactor-next-3-exit-side
description: #112 attempt 1: from after-battle (md1stin, 0x74), 10 frames with no input. g_FieldTriggers points into the field file area (ptr_ok); its gateway 0 leads to md1_1 (0x75, gw0_md1_1); and both ends of gateway 0's line lie on the side the player leaves md1stin by (#77: holding up-left, reactor-next-1): x less than the player's PosX >> 12 (x1s, x2s) and y greater than PosY >> 12 (y1s, y2s). Only signs leave; no coordinate does. gw1_md1_1: gateway 1 leads to md1_1 (diagnostic, in case gateway 0 does not). match: a rerun from the same snapshot.
